tools.name: get_channel_stats
tools.description: Live public stats for a YouTube channel from the official YouTube Data API: subscribers, total views, video count, country, creation date, keywords, topics, and the last 10 uploads with views, likes, comments, length and date, plus averages (views, likes, comments, uploads per month, Shorts share).

tools.name: get_channel_growth
tools.description: Daily subscriber, view and video-count history for a YouTube channel as recorded by Passive Array, with 1, 7, 30, 90 and 365-day change. History starts the day Passive Array first tracked the channel; nothing earlier is backfilled or estimated. Looking a channel up adds it to daily tracking. Costs 1

tools.name: check_monetization
tools.description: Estimates whether a YouTube channel is in the YouTube Partner Program from public signals: subscriber thresholds, uploads in the last 90 days, made-for-kids flags and, when visible, ad placements on recent videos. Returns a verdict with a confidence percentage, never a certainty, and an ad-revenue r

tools.name: compare_channels
tools.description: Side-by-side live stats for two or three YouTube channels: subscribers, total views, videos, average views, likes and comments on recent uploads, upload pace and Shorts share. Costs 2 Passive Array credits.

tools.name: get_video_stats
tools.description: Live stats for up to 50 YouTube videos: title, channel, publish date, views, likes, comments, length, whether it is live, tag count and tags, plus the channel's subscriber count. Costs 1 Passive Array credit.

tools.name: get_video_comments
tools.description: Public comments on a YouTube video or Short, with author, text, likes, reply count and date, plus up to 5 replies per comment. Comments held for review, flagged as spam or deleted are never returned by YouTube's API. Costs 2 Passive Array credits.

tools.name: analyze_video_comments
tools.description: Comment analytics for one public YouTube video or Short: the channel's reply rate, questions without a reply from the channel (most liked first, with links), buying and collab comments, scam spam still visible, busiest comment hours (UTC) and the words viewers use most. Simple visible word rules, no

tools.name: audit_channel_comments
tools.description: Audits a channel's comment section across its latest 5 or 10 uploads: a 0 to 100 comment health score (Passive Array's rubric, every part returned), reply rate, unanswered questions across videos, regular commenters who comment on several videos, buying and collab comments, visible scam spam, commen

tools.name: keyword_research
tools.description: Measured YouTube keyword research: YouTube search autocomplete suggestions for the phrase, the top 10 videos ranking for it today (views, channel size, age, engagement), competition metrics and an opportunity score with its formula. No search-volume number is returned, because nobody outside Google

tools.name: get_outlier_videos
tools.description: Videos that are getting far more views than their channel's usual upload (views divided by the channel's median), from Passive Array's daily scan of tracked channels. Filter by topic, long-form or Shorts, and age. Good for spotting ideas that are working right now. Costs 1 Passive Array credit.

tools.name: estimate_earnings
tools.description: Estimates a channel's monthly and yearly YouTube ad earnings as a range: views on uploads from the last 30 days times an RPM range (what creators keep per 1,000 views). Excludes sponsorships, memberships and merchandise. Costs 1 Passive Array credit.

tools.name: search_channels
tools.description: Finds YouTube channels by keyword or niche, optionally limited to a country (ISO code such as US, GB, IN, BD, PK) and a subscriber range. Returns up to 25 channels with subscribers, views, videos and country. Costs 5 Passive Array credits.

tools.name: get_twitch_channel
tools.description: A Twitch streamer's live data from the official Twitch Helix API (exact follower total, partner status, live status and viewers, recent videos) plus the daily follower history Passive Array has recorded, with 7, 30 and 90-day change. Costs 1 Passive Array credit.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_channel_stats, get_video_stats, get_video_comments · Public sink: get_channel_stats, compare_channels, get_video_stats, get_outlier_videos.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_channel_stats, get_video_stats, get_video_comments · Public sink: get_channel_stats, compare_channels, get_video_stats, get_outlier_videos

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
